# Set up this engagement

Read the [operating rules](../../../docs/operating-rules.md),
[operating model](../../../docs/operating-model.md),
[ADO guide](../../../docs/ado.md) and
[connection template](../../../templates/engagement-connection.md).

1. Confirm this is a separate authorized engagement working folder/session,
   not the vault checkout. Confirm client/engagement names, current person and
   audience. Reconcile relevant Git, GHE, Microsoft 365 and ADO identities;
   never invent roster entries, IDs or assignees.
2. Adopt the business-provided client Team, standard engagement channel, actual
   SharePoint folder and dedicated ADO project. Use readable names with spaces,
   no GET AI prefix or invented engagement IDs; do not predict URLs. Confirm
   workshop-input ownership, ordinary document read access, restricted exceptions
   and separate client publication. Hand missing infrastructure/rights to its
   administrator; creating a channel does not create an ADO project.
3. Keep connection mappings in the engagement workspace, never the vault,
   including ignored storage. A source repository is optional in presales;
   confirm GHE/source/environment references only when needed. Verify
   Teams/SharePoint reads and exact-version access, ADO process/hierarchy/rules,
   and existing parents. Present ambiguous matches for user choice.
4. Confirm how these skills and linked rules are loaded in this interface.
   Record verified date/scope and unknown or denied capabilities distinctly.
   Do not test writes without approval for a real scoped operation.
   Treat document writes/version retrieval as separate capabilities from reads.
5. Return confirmed connections, blockers and next safe action. Do not create
   backlog items, provision resources, build, commit or publish as setup.

Stop if identity, scope, readable instructions or audience cannot be confirmed.
Successful onboarding means verified capabilities, not "all access works".
New team members start with the [onboarding guide](../../../docs/onboarding.md).
